reason: The README clearly describes a Windows desktop notification plugin that alerts users when a root DSH agent turn completes and links the toast to the corresponding Web UI session.

summaries.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DSH 交互式回合完成显示系统通知，并可点击通知返回对应的 Web UI 会话。
summaries.en: Displays Windows system notifications when a DSH interactive turn completes and lets users click through to the corresponding Web UI session.

capabilities: Listens for completed root interactive agent turns
Displays Windows toast notifications through Windows PowerShell and WinRT
Reads the current session title and beginning of the latest AI reply for notification content
Registers and removes a Windows AppUserModelId registry entry
Opens a local DSH Web UI session route in the default browser when a notification is clicked
